title: FBI records on Karl Compton destroyed, FOIA reply

tellings.quote: Quote unquote, records which may [music] have been responsive to your request were destroyed August 30th, 2006.

plain: The FBI's files on the physicist Karl Compton were destroyed, according to a reply from April 2014 to a request made by the records researcher John Greenewald Jr. under FOIA, a US law that lets anyone ask for government records. Michels reads out the reply himself: "records which may have been responsive to your request were destroyed August 30th, 2006." He raises it because Compton's records might have shed light on secret work tied to UFO material, and that trail now ends.
